responsibilities: Mentor and grow the analytics engineering team, fostering a high-performance culture.
Collaborate with cross-functional leadership (Engineering, Product, Architecture) to align data efforts with business goals.
Lead and/or oversee the design, development, and maintenance of scalable DBT and tableau data models following best practices.
Direct the creation of clean semantic layers with fully validated metrics and business logic.
Optimise transformations for performance, cost, and maintainability.
Lead collaboration with analytics engineers to translate business questions into well-structured data models.
Work closely with Data Engineers to ensure upstream pipelines and schemas support downstream needs.
Build documentation, playbooks, and self-serve layers for stakeholders.
Own the development of reusable metrics and business definitions for consistent reporting.
Oversee the building semantic layers where needed.
Conduct exploratory analysis to validate models and understand data behaviours.
Accountable for high standards of data reliability, version control, and CI/CD for analytics code.
Drive data modelling standards across the organisation.
Contribute to data literacy initiatives through documentation and training.
Contribute to the data quality framework (tests, contracts, alerting).
Continue to work in an Agile way, as per our teams.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Accountable for high standards of data reliability, version control, and CI/CD for analytics code.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Reliability, validated metrics, CI/CD and a data quality framework dominate the responsibilities, against a single "fast-paced" in the company description.
evidence.domain_risk: Own the development of reusable metrics and business definitions for consistent reporting.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: A health nonprofit whose platform handles referrals and payments, but the posting's own language is about consistent reporting with no regulatory or financial-reporting terms, so the tie-breaker gives moderate.
evidence.collaboration_width: Engineering; Product; Architecture; Data Engineers; Finance; Operations; analysts
evidence.data_team_maturity: Mentor and grow the analytics engineering team
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An analytics engineering team and separate data engineers already exist and the role grows them ("Mentor and grow the analytics engineering team"), which places the function at mid.
evidence.jd_authorship: Lead and/or oversee the design, development, and maintenance of scalable DBT and tableau data models following best practices.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Some bullets are precise (DBT and tableau data models, semantic layers, tests, contracts, alerting), while others are generic leadership lines such as aligning data efforts with business goals.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Build documentation, playbooks, and self-serve layers for stakeholders.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The main audience is data consumers who self-serve from the modelling and semantic layers ("self-serve layers for stakeholders", "enabling analysts and business teams to self-serve").
evidence.autonomy_level: lead the vision for our data environment
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role sets direction for the data environment and organisation-wide standards ("lead the vision for our data environment", "Drive data modelling standards across the organisation").
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The posting does not mention AI tools or AI-facing data work.
evidence.testing_framing: Contribute to the data quality framework (tests, contracts, alerting).
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: The role is accountable for reliability and CI/CD and contributes to a framework of tests, contracts and alerting, so testing is a responsibility rather than a listed tool.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Accountable for high standards of data reliability
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Reliability and validated metrics are a clear concern, but they sit behind delivery of models and self-serve layers, with no compliance or audit framing.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: design, build, and maintain clean, reliable, well-documented data models
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: New work (semantic layers, playbooks, self-serve layers) sits beside maintaining and optimising existing DBT models, with neither dominating.
evidence.work_arrangement: We are open to remote work for this position and will happily accept applicants from anywhere in Portugal, Kenya and South Africa.
evidence.loss_aversion: Accountable for high standards of data reliability, version control, and CI/CD for analytics code. — reliability is owned, framed as engineering quality rather than regulatory risk.
